_comment: Example config: shared memory /tmp/cam_grabber, 640x480, MOSSE tracker, all target manager features enabled.
Pass via {"config_file": "/path/to/example_shm_mosse_full_tm.json"} and override any field inline.
OPTIONAL   - has a default value, shown in parentheses
MODE-ONLY  - only used when running in that specific mode
_comment_source: REQUIRED for shm mode. shm://... prefix triggers shared memory mode.
_comment_prompt: OPTIONAL (default: empty string = idle start, no tracking until prompt is set)

tracker._comment_tracker_type: OPTIONAL (default: mosse). Options: gat | klt | kcf | mosse
tracker._comment_stability_threshold: OPTIONAL (default: 2). Frames needed to confirm stable lock
tracker._comment_jump_threshold: OPTIONAL (default: 2). Frames to detect tracking jump/break
tracker._comment_proximity_distance: OPTIONAL (default: 25). Pixel distance for proximity matching

logging._comment_log_mode: OPTIONAL (default: debug). Options: debug | long_run | release

target_manager._comment: All OPTIONAL. Target Manager config — KF, gating, SPRT, lifecycle, shadow.
target_manager._comment_enable_kf: Master KF switch. false = raw tracker pass-through, no smoothing/gating/SPRT.
target_manager._comment_enable_gating: false = accept every VLM detection (skip Mahalanobis gate). Useful for debugging.
target_manager._comment_enable_sprt: false = every gate-passing detection is treated as MATCH (no SWITCH possible).
target_manager._comment_min_vlm_confidence: OPTIONAL (default: 0.5). VLM detections below this confidence are rejected as misses. Prevents near-zero-confidence garbage positions from triggering SPRT SWITCH or polluting the KF. UP = stricter, ignores low-confidence detections. DOWN (e.g. 0.001) = accept almost everything.
target_manager._comment_process_noise_accel: How much random acceleration the KF expects (px/s^2). UP = KF trusts tracker more, reacts faster to maneuvers, covariance grows faster. DOWN = smoother output, slower reaction. Example: 5 for a stationary camera, 50 for a handheld drone.
target_manager._comment_r_visual_std: Noise std (px) assigned to visual tracker measurements. IMPORTANT: Should be LARGE (50-100) to prevent visual updates from shrinking position covariance. Visual updates mainly teach velocity from frame-to-frame motion, NOT reduce position uncertainty. Only VLM measurements should shrink covariance. UP = allows P to grow between VLM detections (ellipse expands). DOWN = visual updates shrink P too much (ellipse stays constant).
target_manager._comment_r_vlm_std: Noise std (px) used in the gating covariance S = P + R. UP = wider gate, more VLM detections pass. DOWN = tighter gate, only very close detections pass. Example: 5 for a precise VLM, 30 for a coarse one.
target_manager._comment_r_vlm_min: Best-case VLM noise (px) when confidence=1.0. Used for bridge fusion R scaling. UP = less KF correction even on high-confidence detections. DOWN = strong KF pull toward confident detections.
target_manager._comment_r_vlm_max: Worst-case VLM noise (px) when confidence=0.0. UP = very weak KF pull on low-confidence detections. DOWN = still pulls KF noticeably even with low confidence.
target_manager._comment_p_initial_pos: Initial position uncertainty (px^2). Higher = KF takes longer to converge after init. Example: 50 if first VLM detection is reliable, 500 if it could be far off.
target_manager._comment_p_initial_vel: Initial velocity uncertainty (px^2/s^2). Higher = KF explores velocity space more at start. Example: 10 for slow targets, 200 for fast ones.
target_manager._comment_p_pos_max: Cap on position covariance. Prevents P from growing unbounded between VLM updates, keeping Mahalanobis distances meaningful. UP = gate stays wide longer without VLM. DOWN = gate tightens faster, earlier rejection of far detections.
target_manager._comment_default_dt: Assumed time between frames (seconds) when no prior frame exists. 0.0333 = 30 FPS. Only affects the very first KF predict.
target_manager._comment_gate_threshold: Mahalanobis distance cutoff. 4.0 in 2D ~ 99.97% acceptance. UP = accept farther detections (fewer false rejections, more false accepts). DOWN = reject anything not very close to KF prediction. Example: 3.0 for strict, 6.0 for lenient.
target_manager._comment_sprt_alpha: P(false match). Not directly used when min_match/min_switch set thresholds.
target_manager._comment_sprt_beta: P(missed match). Not directly used when min_match/min_switch set thresholds.
target_manager._comment_sprt_w_spatial: Weight of spatial (distance) evidence in SPRT score. Higher = distance matters more than VLM confidence. Example: 0.8 spatial + 0.2 vlm = mostly trust distance.
target_manager._comment_sprt_w_vlm: Weight of VLM confidence evidence in SPRT score. Higher = confidence matters more than distance. Example: 0.2 spatial + 0.8 vlm = mostly trust VLM confidence.
target_manager._comment_sprt_initial_score: SPRT score at start / after reset. 0 = neutral. Positive = bias toward MATCH. Negative = bias toward SWITCH.
target_manager._comment_sprt_vlm_baseline: Expected VLM confidence for a random/wrong detection. VLM gives 0.5-0.7 even for wrong objects, so 0.5 is realistic. UP = need higher confidence to count as positive evidence. DOWN = even moderate confidence is positive.
target_manager._comment_sprt_score_decay: Leaky integrator: score *= decay before each update. 0.9 = old evidence fades 10% per VLM cycle. UP (closer to 1.0) = longer memory, slower decisions. DOWN (e.g. 0.7) = forgets fast, recent detections dominate.
target_manager._comment_sprt_clamp_score: true = after MATCH/SWITCH decision, clamp score at threshold (prevents runaway). false = score continues accumulating freely.
target_manager._comment_min_switch_detections: How many consecutive worst-case bad VLM detections needed before SWITCH. UP = harder to trigger SWITCH (more tolerant of bad detections). DOWN = faster SWITCH (aggressive). Example: 2 for responsive, 5 for conservative.
target_manager._comment_min_match_detections: How many consecutive best-case good VLM detections needed before MATCH. UP = slower to confirm a match (more cautious). DOWN = 1 good detection triggers MATCH immediately.
target_manager._comment_spatial_llr_cap: Floor on negative spatial evidence per detection. Prevents one far detection (mahal=10 -> LLR=-47) from causing instant SWITCH. UP (e.g. -2.0) = weaker max penalty per detection. DOWN (e.g. -8.0) = stronger penalty, faster SWITCH.
target_manager._comment_sprt_vlm_miss_penalty: SPRT score penalty when VLM returns conf~0 (can't find target). UP = VLM misses push toward SWITCH faster. DOWN = misses are weak evidence, need many to matter. 0 = ignore misses entirely.
target_manager._comment_max_coast_frames: Frames without visual tracker output before CONFIRMED -> COASTING. At 30fps: 45 = 1.5 seconds. UP = wait longer before coasting (tolerant of tracker dropouts). DOWN = enter coasting sooner.
target_manager._comment_coast_to_lost_frames: Frames without visual tracker output before COASTING -> LOST. At 30fps: 90 = 3 seconds. UP = coast longer on KF prediction alone. DOWN = give up sooner.
target_manager._comment_confirm_vlm_count: VLM detections needed in TENTATIVE before CONFIRMED. UP = more VLM confirmations needed (slower but safer lock-on). DOWN = 1 detection confirms immediately (fast but risky). Example: 1 for low-latency, 3 for high-confidence.
target_manager._comment_max_vlm_misses: Consecutive VLM misses (conf~0) before CONFIRMED/COASTING -> LOST. UP = tolerate more misses. DOWN = lose track quickly when VLM can't find target. Example: 1 for aggressive, 5 for patient.
target_manager._comment_bridge_settle_time: Seconds to wait after forwarding VLM detection to tracker before fusing bridge position into KF. Compensates for VLM processing delay. UP = more time for bridge catch-up (smoother but delays fusion). DOWN = fuse sooner (responsive but bridge may not have caught up). 0 for tests.
target_manager._comment_enable_shadow_tracking: true = on SPRT SWITCH, spawn a shadow tracker at VLM position instead of hard-resetting. Shadow must confirm before replacing primary. false = legacy hard SWITCH (instant reset to VLM position).
target_manager._comment_max_shadow_frames: Max frames a shadow can run before timeout. At 30fps: 90 = 3 seconds. If shadow doesn't confirm by then, it's killed and primary resumes. UP = give shadow more time to confirm. DOWN = quick decision.
target_manager._comment_enable_freeze_detection: Detect when tracker locks on background and returns frozen position. true = automatically mark tracker as LOST and retry locking when same position repeats. false = disable freeze detection.
target_manager._comment_max_frozen_frames: Consecutive frames at nearly identical position before marking tracker as LOST. At 30fps: 10 = 0.33 seconds, 15 = 0.5 seconds. UP = more tolerant of slow-moving targets (reduces false positives). DOWN = faster recovery from background lock (more aggressive). Example: 10 for fast-moving, 20 for slow-moving objects.
target_manager._comment_freeze_position_threshold: Max pixel movement to consider position 'frozen' (Euclidean distance). UP = allows more jitter before triggering freeze (tolerant of noisy tracker). DOWN = stricter freeze detection (catches subtle background lock). Example: 1.0 for high-res stable tracking, 3.0 for noisy low-res tracking.
target_manager._comment_sam_enabled: Master toggle. Requires SAM service running at sam_service_url.
target_manager._comment_sam_service_url: SAM segmentation service URL. Empty = disabled.
target_manager._comment_sprt_w_visual: Weight of SAM visual similarity in SPRT. When enabling, rebalance: e.g. w_spatial=0.35 + w_vlm=0.35 + w_visual=0.3 = 1.0. 0 = disabled.
target_manager._comment_sprt_visual_baseline: Expected visual similarity for wrong detection. UP = need higher similarity for positive evidence.
target_manager._comment_sam_reference_update_interval: Frames between SAM reference updates. At 30fps: 60 = 2 seconds, 900 = 30 seconds. Only updates if similarity threshold is met. UP = update less frequently (more stable reference). DOWN = update more frequently (adapts faster to appearance changes).
target_manager._comment_sam_reference_update_similarity: Minimum visual similarity to update SAM reference. 0.5 = moderate match, 0.8 = strong match. Only updates when tracking is stable and similarity is above this threshold. UP = stricter updates (only when very similar). DOWN = more lenient updates (adapts to larger appearance changes).
target_manager._comment_sam_reference_rescue_interval: RESCUE: Force SAM reference update after this many frames regardless of similarity (prevents stuck on bad reference). At 30fps: 90 = 3 seconds, 300 = 10 seconds. Only applies when tracking is stable. Set to 0 to disable rescue updates.
target_manager._comment_distance_enabled: Master toggle. Requires sam_enabled=true (uses SAM for segmentation).
target_manager._comment_distance_hfov_degrees: Camera horizontal FOV in degrees. 90 is typical webcam.
target_manager._comment_distance_default_class: Override object class for prior lookup. Empty = extract from lock prompt.
target_manager._comment_send_frame_image: Include base64 JPEG of detection frame in WebSocket results. Bandwidth-heavy.
target_manager._comment_send_debug_state: Include tracker debug state dict in WebSocket results (lifecycle, KF, SPRT internals). Disable to reduce payload.

_comment_reconnection: Shared by RTSP and shared memory modes. All OPTIONAL.

shared_memory._comment: SHM MODE-ONLY settings. width and height are REQUIRED for shm mode.
shared_memory._comment_width: REQUIRED for shm mode. Frame width in pixels
shared_memory._comment_height: REQUIRED for shm mode. Frame height in pixels
